# Jaisen Mathai

> Personal site of Jaisen Mathai — entrepreneur and software engineer writing about faith, generosity, and building software. Previously led product at Google and founded multiple startups (including OpenPhoto/Trovebox). Author of Elodie, an open-source photo management tool.

## About
- [About this site]({{ site.url }}/about/)
- [Generosity]({{ site.url }}/generosity/): Systematizing radical generosity, inspired by Luke 12:13-21.
- [Startup journey (OpenPhoto/Trovebox)]({{ site.url }}/openphoto-trovebox/)
- [Download Elodie]({{ site.url }}/download-elodie/): Open-source photo management.
